text: Six times six is 42. Gee, I wish that I could add. I like to be as smart as my dad. There's not a figure he don't know. He keeps books for Broadway, though. I had a little rabbit once, and he was an awful dance. But that thing could multiply. And if rabbits can, why can't I? Six times six is 42.
